scope: Native Flat Editor seed 64 on ordinary cave floor. The built-in scenario supplies one rod at 40 HP. Natural actor movement and stairs reached the generated hunter. log: [Scenario] [Sounding] You are in an ordinary cave one floor below wild ground, with a sounding rod in your pack.

[Scenario] [Sounding] 1. Open the pack and choose 'sound the ground'. The row gives the survey reach. The strike can draw nearby creatures that hunt by sound. sections.Heading: Decision details
sections.Text:
You see a sounding rod.
How to use: Press C on your own cell and choose sound the ground (or choose it from the pack). The stone answers with a bearing and a rough distance for unseen open ground, a bore through stone, or dense rock. Choose read the survey log to read back your last 8 soundings.
Needs: an ordinary cave floor below the surface, including dry bare rock in a natural cave; the rod in your pack.
Cost and limits: Survey reach depends on the stone (12 to 30 paces). It reports only terrain and nothing nearer than 4 paces. It uses nothing up. The strike rings through the stone and can draw nearby creatures that hunt by sound.
Right now you can: sound the ground (survey up to 14 paces). Not now: read the survey log (You have not sounded anything with this rod yet).

An iron-shod ash rod with a striking collar.
1 unit. Weight per unit: 4. Total weight: 4.
Lift Strength: 3; yours: 18.
You can carry this item.
Grip: one hand.
sounding rod cannot be thrown.
Pack weight: 16; with this item: 16. Burden threshold: 270.
